data.deletion_protocol: The headline analysis deletes nothing. All 354 epochs enter train and test and gross errors are handled by the Huber loss. A deletion variant is reported as a robustness check only.
data.test_window_note: The held-out window is three observing campaigns and a tail, not a uniform span.
data.horizon_bin_note: The reporting rule replaced the calendar bins with synodic ones. The superseded counts are kept here because they are the reason: three of the four buckets held fewer than 4 epochs and still carried a quoted median.
data.date_correction: JD is taken from Pafko column 14 plus 1721048.0, which equals julian_calendar_to_jd(year, month, day, hour, minute) on all 923 rows to 4.66e-10 day, float64 resolution at JD 2.3e6. The minute column is mandatory: without it the identity fails by up to 0.0410 day, 59 minutes. A loader that anchors Pafko's decimal date on the Julian New Year, although Pafko already applied the 10 day Gregorian shift, runs a median 9.75 days late, range 9.50 to 10.25; that convention is not used here.

shift_decision_table.note: Median absolute error of the unfitted modern elements with every timestamp shifted by s days. The convention is decided by this table, not by the arithmetic argument.

gross_error_census.criterion: abs residual against unfitted modern elements above 60 arcmin
gross_error_census.note: 18 gross errors, 9 of them outright north to south sign flips; the rest are large errors of other kinds. The declination column is internally consistent with the sign column on all 923 rows, so these are source or transcription errors, not a loader sign bug.

outlier_detector.method: robust local quadratic, window 45 days, at least 8 neighbours, Huber weights at 5 arcmin, threshold 60 arcmin, iterated; computed on jd < split_jd only
outlier_detector.note: Used for the census and the deletion robustness check only; the headline fits see every epoch. The recall ceiling is the training share of the gross errors, and the epochs it cannot reach are isolated ones with too few neighbours for any local smoothness test.

sanity_modern_elements.note: Declination predicted from JPL secular mean elements extrapolated to 1591, never fitted. Validates frames, units and calendar, and is the zero-parameter ceiling the fitted models are judged against.

epicycle_frequencies.note: Greedy forward selection on the training window only, run once per loss: sum of squares for the L2 arm, Huber cost for the robust arm.

epicycle_cv.protocol: Forward chaining inside the training span only: fit on t < cut, validate on the next 20 percent of the training span, five cuts at 50 to 90 percent. Blocked five fold for comparison. The frequency ordering is recomputed inside every fold and the test period is never touched. Fold criterion: root mean square validation residual.
epicycle_cv.selector_disagreement_note: The two selectors disagree, K = 3 forward against K = 13 blocked. Both are reported; neither is presented alone.

headline.l2_ablation_note: results.models holds the same families under ordinary least squares. Those numbers are an ablation: 99.0 percent of the training sum of squares comes from 15 of 268 epochs.

refraction_analysis.note: Tycho measured at meridian transit from latitude 55.9070 N, so transit altitude is 34.093 plus the declination. True refraction at 6 degrees altitude is about 8.5 arcmin and Tycho's own table was truncated and partly wrong, so the residual against unfitted modern elements is altitude dependent and the two windows do not sample the same altitudes.

altitude_model.form: robust linear in transit altitude, fitted on training epochs only

altitude_corrected_refit.correction: Subtract the training-window robust linear altitude model from every declination, then refit kepler6 under the same Huber loss and seed.

consequence.statement: The median signed residual moves by about 3.30 arcmin between the two windows over windows that sample different transit altitudes. Its ratio to the 10.64 arcmin train to test median absolute error gap is descriptive and is not an explained share. The corrected refit measures the effect of the fitted altitude term directly.

synthetic_observation_physics.note: Known-truth recovery on the exact Tycho sampling. Declinations come from modern elements at jd_ref. The altitude term is estimated on non-gross training epochs only. Gross injections use the actual observed-minus-modern residual at the same 18 gross epochs. Condition v is exactly the observed declination vector and must reproduce the real-data held-out result.

knowledge_budget.declaration: models.fit_kepler seeds its first restart with the modern JPL elements. That is external prior knowledge, not test leakage, and the benchmark's knowledge budget requires it to be declared. The ablation below repeats the fit with include_modern_start=False and 60 blind random restarts.

l2.verdict: the blind search reaches the same optimum, so the result does not depend on the modern element start

huber.verdict: the blind search reaches the same optimum, so the result does not depend on the modern element start

deletion_robustness_check.note: The 11 epochs flagged by the training window detector are deleted and the headline Keplerian fit is repeated under the same Huber loss. Reported beside the no-deletion numbers; the headline deletes nothing.

provenance.input_file: data/historical/mars_declinations.csv, rebuilt locally by keplerbench fetch-historical
provenance.determinism_note: Every fit is seeded and every bootstrap reseeds from the recorded seed inside the call, so two runs agree on every numeric field apart from wall_seconds and utc_timestamp.
